start_message:
Welcome to the VPN bot!

Here you can buy VPN access and manage your subscriptions.
payment_success: Payment successful! Creating your VPN key...
vpn_created: Your VPN key has been created! Connection link: {link} Save this link and use it in your VPN client.
no_vpns: You don't have any active VPN keys yet.
confirm_delete: Are you sure you want to delete this VPN key?
instructions_text:
Connection instructions:

1. Download the Happ app (iOS/Android/PC)
2. Import the configuration via link
3. Connection settings:
   - Enable Fragmentation
   - Enable Noise
   - Enable Routing
   - Select the "Ru-Direct" rule (appears automatically after importing the subscription)
4. Click the connect button
support_text: If you have any questions, contact support: {support}
error_occurred: An error occurred. Please try again later.
vpn_creation_failed: Failed to create VPN key. Administrator has been notified.
renewal_failed: Failed to renew subscription. Please try again later.
